index.title: What's happening at TiE Siliguri
index.summary: A monthly rhythm of masterclasses, mixers and mentoring — plus the flagship moments that define the chapter's year.
intro: TiE Siliguri runs at least one curated session every month, from practitioner-led masterclasses to members-only networking mixers. Some are open to guests; some are exclusive to members.
Below is what's coming up next. For the full story of the chapter so far, browse everything we've hosted since launch.

upcoming.title: Coming up next
upcoming.summary: The next sessions on the TiE Siliguri calendar. Members can register through the chapter team.
upcoming.empty: No events are scheduled right now — check back soon, or reach the chapter team to hear what's next.

past.title: The story so far
past.summary: Every session TiE Siliguri has hosted since the chapter launched on 30 July 2025.
past.empty: Our first events are on the way — check back soon.

upcoming.title: Introducing AI Roundtable
upcoming.summary: A peer-learning session where entrepreneurs learn from each other, share how they're using AI, and solve real business use cases together. Bring a real AI challenge from your business and leave with ideas you can put to work.
upcoming.imageAlt: Event creative for the Introducing AI Roundtable session

upcoming.title: Define Your Entrepreneurial Edge
upcoming.summary: Executive strategies for aspiring entrepreneurs, startups and SMEs with Dr Rajeev Roy — Director of First Bridge Business School, former Dean at XLRI and author of Entrepreneurship (Oxford).
upcoming.imageAlt: Event creative for Define Your Entrepreneurial Edge with Dr Rajeev Roy

upcoming.title: Masters' Union Founders' Immersion
upcoming.venue: Masters' Union School of Business, Gurugram
upcoming.summary: An exclusive, practitioner-led programme for founders and family business owners covering business growth, AI for business and family business succession — taught inside an ecosystem of Fortune 500 companies.
upcoming.imageAlt: Event creative for the Masters' Union Founders' Immersion in Gurugram

upcoming.title: DPDP Act Decoded: Data Privacy, Protection & Your Business
upcoming.summary: Phone numbers, employee data, WhatsApp, Google Forms, vendor data-sharing — how many DPDP violations are already happening in your business? A practical masterclass on the Digital Personal Data Protection Act with CA Simran Saria Bansal, Partner at Bansal S S & Co.
upcoming.imageAlt: Event creative for the DPDP Act Decoded masterclass with CA Simran Saria Bansal
